Logical Model: ProcessRequest — Remiss (begäran)

Official URL: https://fhir.inera.se/ig/clinicalprocess-activity-request/StructureDefinition/processrequest Version: 2.2.0
Draft as of 2026-09-26 Computable Name: ProcessRequest

Copyright/Legal: Copyright 2024 Inera AB. Licensieras under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

Logisk modell för begäran i ProcessRequest (RIV-TA urn:riv:clinicalprocess:activity:request:ProcessRequestResponder:2, element request av typen RequestType). Remittenten skickar en allmänremiss till remissmottagaren. Svaret är enbart ett resultat, se ProcessResult.

Usages:

  • Use this Logical Model: ProcessRequestOutcome — Remissvar (begäran)

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
activity-request-activity-code-or-text error processrequest.questionFormulation.desiredActivity Åtgärd: ange antingen text eller kod, inte båda (schematron Verify desiredActivity) (activityText.exists() and activityCode.exists()).not()
activity-request-commitmenttype-chapter error processrequest.paymentCommitment commitmentTypeChapter är obligatoriskt då commitmentType = 1 (schematron Verify paymentCommitment) commitmentType.coding.where(code = '1').exists() implies commitmentTypeChapter.exists()
activity-request-condition-code-or-text error processrequest.questionFormulation.condition Kliniskt tillstånd: ange antingen text eller kod, inte båda (schematron Verify condition) (conditionText.exists() and conditionCode.exists()).not()
processrequest-vr-intermediary error processrequest Om versionsorsak är VR (vidareskickad remiss) måste intermediaryParticipant anges (schematron Verify intermediaryParticipant) reasonForVersion.typeOfReason = 'VR' implies intermediaryParticipant.exists()
